summary: Iteration-4 VIN Decode Enrichment fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests PASS including 4 new VIN tests. POST /api/vin/decode with '1C4HJXEG9JW174532' returns validFormat=true, source=nhtsa, confidence=0.95, make=JEEP, year=2018, model=Wrangler, plus trim/engine/transmission/drivetrain/plant. Invalid VIN 'BADVIN123' returns validFormat=false, confidence=0 (no crash). Cache-hit returns identical make/year/model on repeat calls. /vin/decode correctly requires auth (401 unauthenticated). 'save-to-garage' transitions to 'SAVED TO GARAGE'. 'open-blediag' -> /ble-diagnostics loads obd-log + freeze frame. AI Repair Assistant chat (chat-input/send-button) with the connected 2018 Jeep returns a coherent JARVIS reply referencing P0300 misfire and 820 rpm idle (vehicle context injected). REGRESSION: Live Diagnostics tab shows '43 PIDs' badge with Engine RPM/Vehicle Speed/Boost/MAF etc; Health screen shows 12 subsystem scores + all 4 DTCs (P0300, P0171, P0456, P0128) with AI Diagnostic Findings; Reports shows saved reports (2018 Jeep Wrangler entries) with no red-screen; login flow works. Deprecated packages detected: none (SafeAreaView/expo-av not in use). Only console noise: RN-web deprecation warnings for shadow* style props, props.pointerEvents, and Image style.resizeMode.

issues: RN-web deprecation warnings still fire on many screens: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' (use style.pointerEvents), and 'Image style.resizeMode' (use props.resizeMode). Cosmetic only.
